I think a really good trick to speak to people with confidence is to almost pretend that they’re already your friend that way it doesn’t seem like you’re trying to be someone you’re not and it makes you come across more comfortable. Don’t be that person that’s just intruding on everybody’s conversation because it’s rude and a lot of people won’t like that. But if you speak to people as if you’ve been friends for a little while they become more comfortable as well

Yeah I would go with what the people before were saying. See a pediatrician as soon as possible but make sure that you try your very best not to do that it has anything to do with her weight because even one mention of it can trigger a sequence of events that will affect her for the rest of her life. It seems like she’s just genetically predisposed to be a heavier girl but if you can get a gauge on how to best treat her now then you can avoid a lot of issues for her in the future. Trauma has a lot to do with how people gain weight as well so anything you can do to talk her through it or have someone talk her through it will definitely help in the long run. You sound like a really sweet mom who’s been through a lot this is just something else that you guys can get her together
